question: The ratio of the lengths of two corresponding sides of two similar triangles is 3 : 10.The ratio of the areas of these two triangles, in the order mentioned, is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For **similar triangles**, the ratio of their **areas** is equal to the **square** of the ratio of their **corresponding sides**.

Ratio of sides = 3 : 10

Ratio of areas = 3² : 10²

⇒ Ratio of areas = (3 × 3) : (10 × 10) = 9 : 100
